# Open problems

Every open problem or conjecture not Proved or Disproved, plus every Not settled claim. Generated by `py tools/kb.py build`.

## GEO — geometry

- [GEO-11](claims/GEO-11.md) — Not settled — Any commutator is even, so the GEO-10 test only bites with two distinct even cycle lengths, needing n ≥ 6; exhaustive search on n ≤ 5 finds no failing pair
- [GEO-19](claims/GEO-19.md) — Not settled — Given OA-3 data, M/Φ is a rectangle-tiled garage iff trivially-stabilised vertices have angle 2π and μν-only-fixed ones 4π; would make PA-4, PA-5w, PA-6 decidable
- [GEO-22](claims/GEO-22.md) — Not settled (draft; not yet through /verify-claim) — Draft: for a garage unfolding, G is regular iff abelian iff the commutator is trivial iff P is a rectangle (PA-7)
- [GEO-23](claims/GEO-23.md) — Not settled (draft; not yet through /verify-claim) — Draft: if [σ,τ] has a fixed point, every normal origami M covers is a torus; so a PA-4 unfolding's maximal normal quotient is its torus quotient, where (Q2) holds
- [GEO-24](claims/GEO-24.md) — Not settled (draft; not yet through /verify-claim) — Draft: under GA-RD (hence PA-4) [σ,τ] restricted to each block is a square in Sym(B_e), so each even cycle length occurs evenly per block; refines GEO-10 blockwise
- [GEO-25](claims/GEO-25.md) — Not settled (draft; not yet through /verify-claim) — Draft: GEO-12 and GEO-24 exclude from PA-4 every M_N(a) with N ≢ 2 mod 4 (whenever some a_j is a unit), including all N = 12 members

## OBS — obstructions and mechanisms

- [OBS-6](claims/OBS-6.md) — Not settled (draft; not yet through /verify-claim) — Draft: A′ is a union of three cyclic subgroups iff A′ ≅ (Z/2)²×Z/k, k odd; other non-cyclic A′ fail (Q2). For |A_p|=8 the failing data are A_p ≅ Z/2×Z/4, χ(x,y)=y mod 2 (16 squares).
- [OBS-7](claims/OBS-7.md) — Not settled (draft; not yet through /verify-claim) — Draft: for finite H ≤ Aff(M), x̄ illuminates ȳ in M/H iff x illuminates some hy in M; non-illumination in the quotient lifts, the converse needs every hy unlit; pairs identified by H collapse.
- [OBS-12](claims/OBS-12.md) — Not settled (draft; not yet through /verify-claim) — Draft: all 13 / 28 proper block systems give quotient origamis satisfying (Q2), and the images of (i, T^{±1}i) there either coincide or are met; so the failure is not lifted from a quotient origami.
- [OBS-13](claims/OBS-13.md) — Not settled (draft; not yet through /verify-claim) — Draft: if Df = −I and fx ≠ x, then x illuminates fx iff f² = 1 and x illuminates some regular fixed point of f.
- [OBS-14](claims/OBS-14.md) — Not settled (draft; not yet through /verify-claim) — Draft: in M/⟨g⟩ the pair (x, Tx) is illuminated when gT is an involution with regular fixed points; otherwise the non-illumination descends, but only equivalently, via OBS-13.
- [OBS-15](claims/OBS-15.md) — Not settled (draft; not yet through /verify-claim) — Draft: no D₄; every OA-3 K₄-quotient is non-orientable (so not PA-4); N8's own K₄ does not carry the failure; all but three of member 2's 36 K₄'s have explicit witnesses.
- [OBS-16](claims/OBS-16.md) — Not settled (draft; not yet through /verify-claim) — Draft: for both M_12 members the unmet orbitals gr(T^{±1}) are not the lift of an unmet pair on any quotient examined; the mechanism is the Z/6 core monodromy of M → M/⟨T⟩ missing the generators.
- [OBS-17](claims/OBS-17.md) — Not settled (draft; not yet through /verify-claim) — Draft, under GA-EP: if an orbital inside {ι=0} has a pair whose coset holds no square of a C^pow element, (Q2) fails; normal form: some 1 ≠ E ∈ G₀ is not a square in G.
- [OBS-19](claims/OBS-19.md) — Not settled (draft; not yet through /verify-claim) — Draft: if M → M′ → T² and a pair of distinct squares of M′ is not in R^pow(M′), no pair over it is in R^pow(M). Also: at PA-4 the normal/quotient parity obstruction is always absent.
- [OBS-20](claims/OBS-20.md) — Not settled (draft; not yet through /verify-claim) — Draft: translation automorphisms of a PA-4 garage exist only when PA-SC fails; for a regular garage cover with group D, (CT′)(i) holds for all deck elements iff folded-core monodromies cover D.
- [OBS-21](claims/OBS-21.md) — Not settled (draft; not yet through /verify-claim) — Draft: for a non-normal garage cover P → P′, pairs in a common fibre within one K₄-copy have d = 0; if D₀ also has a pair in different fibres outside every gr(T), then GA-2T′ fails.

## COMP — computational foundations

- [COMP-1](claims/COMP-1.md) — Not settled — Lower Christoffel words in the four sign quadrants represent each primitive class of F_2 once (cited); still open: (Q2) is GL(2,Z)-invariant, hence constant on a Teichmüller curve.
- [COMP-2](claims/COMP-2.md) — Not settled — States (g1,g2) simultaneously conjugate by G (by G^+ under OA-3) have conjugate subtrees, so one per class leaves R^pow unchanged; states drop from |G|² to the class count.
- [COMP-3](claims/COMP-3.md) — Not settled — Replacing Z/M by a finite abelian A and parity by a character χ with χ(a_j)=1 should give the abelian square-tiled surfaces; unproved, and the match with Wright's normalisation is open.
- [COMP-4](claims/COMP-4.md) — Not settled — Restates three proved necessary conditions for the pipeline: each T≠1 in the centraliser acts as a power of some u on a ⟨u⟩-orbit; GA-D0 when n>|A|; every G-orbital is met.
- [COMP-5](claims/COMP-5.md) — Not settled (draft; not yet through /verify-claim) — Sketch: for T of prime order, GA-CT′(i) fails iff the class of M→M/⟨T⟩ vanishes on every rational cylinder core; computable from cusp representatives without enumerating G.

## OPEN — open problems and conjectures

- [OPEN-1](claims/OPEN-1.md) — Not settled — Is there a (Q2) counterexample at PA-4, i.e. an origami that is the unfolding of a rectangle-tiled parking garage? All known counterexamples (CEX-1, CEX-3, CEX-4) are OA-3 but not PA-4
- [OPEN-2](claims/OPEN-2.md) — Not settled — Conjecture: under PA-6 the G-orbitals are exactly the level sets of inv=(d,z); true on ten examples and under GA-HA. It would give (Q2) ⇔ GA-CT′ at PA-6 by CRIT-17.
- [OPEN-3](claims/OPEN-3.md) — Not settled — Open 5.A: find a 3-cycle in H^+ when no corner type has a unique reflex vertex, so that CRIT-19 gives GA-HA. The file also holds Open 5.B's verbatim text (see OPEN-4).
- [OPEN-4](claims/OPEN-4.md) — Partial — Characterise fold-imprimitive polyominoes; conjecture: imprimitive iff a grid-line/lattice-point symmetry or Λ≠2Z². Partial: the obstructions are known
- [OPEN-5](claims/OPEN-5.md) — Not settled — For a half-turn symmetry of P no general direction with a T_θ-invariant orbit is known; S-tetromino and plus-pentomino data; conjecture: some direction with |p|+|q|≤3 works.
- [OPEN-6](claims/OPEN-6.md) — Not settled — Proposed replacement for the disproved BOUND-1: for a polyomino (PA-6), directions with |p|+|q| ≤ max(width,height)+1 already give (Q2). Not settled.
- [OPEN-7](claims/OPEN-7.md) — Not settled — Answered arithmetically by OBS-4/OBS-5, and geometrically for the two CEX-1 members by OBS-10/OBS-11; open for other M_N(a) (needs OBS-10's hypotheses per member or the FMZ labelling).
- [OPEN-8](claims/OPEN-8.md) — Not settled — OBS-5 (N16) proves gcd(a_i+a_j,N)≠2 for all six pairs is sufficient for (Q2) to fail on M_N(a); necessity is checked only by data for N≤18
- [OPEN-9](claims/OPEN-9.md) — Not settled — BOUND-4 leaves n=18 (p=3, |Q|=9, f=2) open for the mechanism; whether any (Q2) counterexample has fewer than 16 squares is open (spec S2)
- [OPEN-11](claims/OPEN-11.md) — Not settled — Would turn the one-step block reduction (CRIT-18) into an induction, since block quotients inherit OA-3 (GEO-5); an odd number of minimal block systems forces one, but that is only a condition.
- [OPEN-12](claims/OPEN-12.md) — Not settled — Does (Q1) hold for PA-6 unfoldings with k≥1, i.e. not rectangles (GEO-17)? Rectangles fail it by CRIT-1. Secondary: a few examples suffice.
